$comment: Thresholds for the ARIA external watchdog (PLAN Wave 1, moved forward from Wave 11).
Data, not code: an operator changes a number here, and the invariant spec pins that
the workflow reads them from this file rather than carrying its own copy.
The hours are derived from the schedules they watch, not chosen freely:
the producer runs at 01:13 and the executor at 02:29 daily, so one missed night is
within tolerance and two is not. A threshold tighter than the cadence would page on
a single retry; one looser than two cadences would let a silent week pass.

stateBranch.$comment: The ONE signal no other watchdog carries: the branch tip must MOVE. A lane can run green every night and publish nothing - ORPHAN-CRITICAL-484's exact shape - and a run-status watchdog reads that as health.
